# `aitbc workflow list`

List all available workflows from the coordinator.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc workflow list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc workflow list
```
